answer_1.quote: Our model can produce comprehensive summaries with multi-perspective viewpoints as inductive answers for the low-resource domain ...
answer_1.outputs: Multi-perspective inductive answers that combine objective product facts and subjective opinions

answer_2.quote: We further used BLEU (B_n) and ROUGE (R_n) to measure the generated quality of the inductive answer.

answer_4.quote: We further used human evaluations to qualitatively evaluate the answer's quality. To finely analyze the inductive answer, we employed four metrics, including Factness (Fact) and Accuracy (Acc) ... Comprehensiveness (Comp) and Template Compliance (Tcp). We recruited 8 undergraduate students ... each annotator evaluated around 250 randomly sampled answers.
answer_4.guideline: The key metrics included Factness, Accuracy, Comprehensiveness, and Template Compliance.
